name: Forgejo
summary: Sign in to Codeberg and other Forgejo servers, clone from your account and organizations, and open links.

capabilities.reason: Talks to the Forgejo servers you add to sign you in and list repositories.
Keeps your Forgejo sign-ins in your system's secret store.
Opens your Forgejo server in your browser to sign in.
Remembers the accounts you added and caches avatars.
Reads a variable that points it at a test server during development.
